spans.s:
m. (-णः)
1 A wart, a mole.
2 A scar.
3 A corn, a callosity.
4 An insect found in wood.

f. (-णिः)
A tree, (Achyranthes aspera): see अपामार्ग.
E.
किण् a scar, and कि affix; making scars; that is cicatrizing wounds, sores, &c.

f. (-ही)
Achyranthes aspera.
E.
किणि a sore, and ह what removes, fem. affix ङीष्.

mn. (-ण्वः-ण्वं)
Ferment, a drug or seed used to produce fermentation, in the manufacture of spirits from sugar, bassia, &c.
n. (-ण्वं)
Sin.
E.
कण to sound, &c. क्वन् Uṇādi affix, and the इ irregularly inserted: see कण्व.
